firstRun.title: Welcome aboard
firstRun.text: Your library is ready for its first tracks.

repair.title: Welcome back aboard
repair.text: Everything is as you left it.

python.title: This machine needs Python
python.lead: Sonarche runs on two Python tools, yt-dlp and beets, so it needs Python 3.10 or newer. Nothing gets installed into it: the app builds its own environment alongside.
python.hint: Run the command in a terminal, then come back here.

lead.firstRun: Two tools power the app: yt-dlp fetches the audio, beets files and tags it. They're installed once.
lead.repair: After an update or a reset, the tools that download and file your music need to be put back in place.

bundled.title: A few seconds
bundled.text: Everything ships with the app: nothing to download.

online.title: A few minutes
online.text: Long enough to download the packages, depending on your connection.

firstRun.title: Your music will live in {{path}}
firstRun.text: Plain files, yours, sorted by artist and album.

repair.title: Your library stays put
repair.text: Your tracks, tags and playlists stay where they are.

isolated.title: Nothing installed elsewhere
isolated.text: A separate folder, just for Sonarche.

lead.bundled: Keep this window open. Everything ships with the app, nothing goes over the network.
lead.online: Keep this window open. The packages are downloading, this can take a few minutes.

packages.title: Install yt-dlp and beets
packages.text: Fetch the audio, then file and tag it

finalize.title: Finish the setup
finalize.text: Prepare how your library is filed

lead.firstRun: One optional step left: letting Sonarche recognise your tracks.
lead.repair: Your library is waiting, exactly as you left it.

lead.firstRun: Nothing on your machine was changed. Fix the issue below, then try again.
lead.repair: Your library wasn't touched. Fix the issue below, then try again.

diskFull.title: Not enough disk space
diskFull.hint: Free up some room on this disk, then run the installation again.

permission.title: Access to a folder was denied
permission.hint: Sonarche couldn't write to its own folder. Check your account's permissions on this disk, then run the installation again.

network.title: No connection
network.hint: The installation downloads its packages. Check your connection, then run the installation again.

intro.title: A key to identify your tracks
intro.lead: With an AcoustID key, Sonarche listens to each file and finds the real track. Without one, it guesses from the title.

sound.title: Identified by sound
sound.text: The file's audio fingerprint, not the video title.

free.title: Two minutes, and free
free.text: An AcoustID account and an application to register.

guessed.title: Without a key, guessed tags
guessed.text: Your tracks arrive flagged as such, to review later.

steps.title: Get your AcoustID key
steps.lead: Two pages to open on acoustid.org, then paste the key here. It's free.

account.title: Create an AcoustID account
account.text: Or sign in with an existing one.
account.open: Open acoustid.org to create an account

application.title: Register an application
application.text: Name it anything: the key shows right after.
application.open: Open acoustid.org to register an application

paste.title: Paste the application key
paste.text: The application's key, not the account's.

verified.title: Key saved
verified.lead: Every track you add will be identified by its fingerprint: artist, album, year.

rejected.title: This key isn't recognised
rejected.lead: Make sure you copied the application key, not the account key, then try again.

key.unreachable: Could not reach AcoustID. Check your connection and try again.

saved.title: Your AcoustID key is already saved
saved.lead: Sonarche keeps identifying your tracks by sound. Nothing to do here, unless you want to change it.

caption.waiting: The Ark is waiting for its engine.
caption.stranded: A crate was left on the quay.
caption.listening: It recognises every track by ear.
caption.unknownKey: That key doesn't ring a bell.
